launcher.title: BD2 Launcher
launcher.top_note: BD2 Launcher · Settings stay on this computer
launcher.directory.heading:
Start with the
game directory.
launcher.directory.lead:
Select the installed game folder.
We will check the game executable and asset files before setting up the connection.
launcher.directory.label: BrownDust II · Client setup
launcher.directory.title: Select game directory
launcher.directory.description_mac: Select %[1]s or the folder that contains it.
launcher.directory.hint: Enter a path directly or browse for a folder.
launcher.directory.note: This step only checks files; it does not modify game assets.
launcher.directory.found: Game executable and asset file found.
launcher.directory.incomplete: Check complete; review the missing items in the launcher.
launcher.directory.changed: The directory changed; check it again.
launcher.server.heading:
Next, set up
the server.
launcher.server.lead:
Enter the address of the server to connect to.
In the launcher you can then choose a resource source, apply the patch, and install plugins.
launcher.server.label: Directory selected · You can still change it later
launcher.server.title: Server address
launcher.server.description: Enter the full address; a port may be included.
launcher.server.hint:
Example: %[1]s
Do not add %[2]s or any other path. The LI plugin reads the actual connection address.
launcher.desk.subtitle: Manage connection settings and get the game ready to launch.
launcher.connection.title: Connection settings
launcher.proxy.title: Set proxy
launcher.proxy.manual_missing: Manual HTTP proxy · Address not entered
launcher.proxy.address_hint: Enter http://host:port. Credentials, paths, and query parameters are not supported.
launcher.proxy.apply_hint: Changes take effect the next time the game launches. localhost, 127.0.0.1, and ::1 always connect directly.
launcher.proxy.https_hint: The HTTP proxy carries the game's HTTPS connections through CONNECT, and certificates are still verified. Browsers use their own proxy settings.
launcher.resources.title: Resource source
launcher.resources.official.name: Official CDN
launcher.resources.official.description: Downloads resources from official servers without using the server owner's bandwidth for large files.
launcher.resources.local.name: Downloaded local resources
launcher.resources.local.description: Reads ServerData and GameData already on this computer instead of downloading the same files again.
launcher.resources.server.name: Server-provided resources
launcher.resources.server.description: The server supplies the resource URLs; its owner can host a private CDN or reverse-proxy the official CDN.
launcher.resources.local_note: The selected directory must contain both %[1]s and %[2]s.
launcher.resources.hint.official: In official mode the client connects directly to the release-locked official CDN.
launcher.resources.hint.local: Local mode does not call the server resource API; the resources must still match the current client version.
launcher.resources.hint.server: Private hosting and reverse proxying are the same source to the client; the server returns the resource URLs.
launcher.resources.policy_official: The client uses release-locked official URLs
launcher.resources.policy_server: Resource URLs supplied by the server
launcher.unsaved: Current settings have not been saved.
launcher.prepare.title: Patch and plugins
launcher.prepare.note: Close the game first. The patch only changes the built-in Intro address and keeps a %[1]s backup. Install BepInEx manually before installing plugins.
launcher.status.label: Client status
launcher.status.title: Current status
launcher.status.foot: Status comes from local file checks and does not mean the server is online.
launcher.log.title: Recent activity
launcher.log.idle_hint: Select the game directory to start checking.
launcher.footer.local_only: Settings are saved only on your computer
launcher.footer.no_secrets: Account credentials and server-owner keys are never saved
launcher.quit.title: The launcher has exited
launcher.quit.hint: You can close this page now.
launcher.steps.label: Setup progress
launcher.editor.title: Edit settings
launcher.editor.note: After editing, save the connection settings in the launcher.
launcher.dialog.game_directory: Select the Brown Dust II installation directory
launcher.dialog.resource_directory: Select the CDN directory containing ServerData and GameData
launcher.error.bridge: The native client interface is not ready
launcher.error.directory_required: Select the game installation directory first
launcher.error.origin_invalid: Enter a complete server address, for example %[1]s
launcher.error.origin_shape: Enter only an HTTP(S) address and port, without a path, query parameters, or account details
launcher.error.origin_https: Public and LAN servers must use HTTPS; only local loopback addresses may use HTTP
launcher.error.resources_required: Select a local CDN directory containing ServerData and GameData
launcher.error.proxy_invalid: Enter an HTTP proxy address such as %[1]s; only a host and port are supported

backend.launcher_updating: The launcher is updating; start the game after it finishes
backend.game_running_plugins: The game is running; its plugins update after it exits
backend.official_cdn: The client will use the release-locked official CDN
backend.patched: Client entry point patched; the original backup was retained
backend.patch_current: Client patch is already complete; no asset file was rewritten
backend.plugins_installed: BD2 client plugins installed or updated
backend.plugins_current: BD2 client plugins are already up to date; no DLL was rewritten
backend.game_running: Brown Dust II is already running
backend.plugins_rejected: Server %[1]s no longer accepts these plugins: %[2]s. Update the plugins in the launcher first
update.game.exit_hint: Close all game instances. The launcher downloads and verifies the required game and resources before the next launch.
update.restarting: The launcher is about to restart
update.plugins.ready_hint: It takes effect after the running game exits.
update.plugins.updated_waiting: Plugins updated to %[1]s; running games pick them up after they exit
update.plugins.applied_after_exit: The game exited; the plugin update has been applied
backend.server_maintenance: The server is updating; try again after it finishes
backend.game_mismatch: Server game version %[1]s does not match client game version %[2]s
